privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This placeholder privacy policy explains how Valix temporarily handles data for testing and preview purposes. We will replace it with final legal language before launch.

sections.heading: Information we collect
body: We currently store only the data you provide when creating an account, uploading CSV files, or validating emails in this preview environment.
Until the production launch, no third-party trackers or advertising cookies are enabled across the app.

sections.heading: How we use data
body: Uploaded contact lists and validation results are processed solely to demonstrate product features and may be deleted at any time.
Aggregated metrics help us improve deliverability scoring, but we do not sell, rent, or share any personal data.

sections.heading: Your choices
body: You can delete your workspace data by contacting the team or clearing your account in the dashboard.
When the final policy goes live, it will include regional rights, retention timelines, and subprocessors.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These draft terms describe how Valix should be used during the beta period. We will publish comprehensive terms, including payment and compliance clauses, prior to accepting live customers.

sections.heading: Acceptance of terms
body: By accessing this preview you confirm that you are evaluating Valix for internal testing only and will not upload regulated or production data.
Continued use after the official launch will require agreeing to the final contract that supersedes this notice.

sections.heading: Use of the service
body: You may experiment with single and bulk email validation features but must respect applicable anti-spam and privacy laws in your jurisdiction.
We reserve the right to suspend access for misuse, abusive traffic, or attempts to reverse engineer our infrastructure.

sections.heading: Liability and support
body: During the beta the platform is offered “as is” without uptime guarantees, warranties, or production SLAs.
Reach out to legalvalix.dev to request clarifications or report issues so we can improve the final agreement.
